lines.2: 「W-what is it, Tsushima? What did you want to talk about...?」
lines.3: She was usually so tense, but now she was fidgeting.
lines.6: 「If we try harder, everyone will understand!」
lines.8: Konoe said she would push even harder.
lines.9: After everything they'd done to her, she still planned to hurt herself more?
lines.10: 「--Konoe. This situation is getting really bad.」
lines.12: 「People are talking behind your back constantly. You're becoming isolated.」
lines.13: 「At this rate, you're really going to end up alone.」
lines.15: 「Don't get worked up or carried away. Fit in with the people around you.」
lines.16: 「The play will probably turn out lousy, but for now... okay?」
lines.17: I said it as gently as I could.
lines.19: 「What are you saying!? You too, Tsushima!?」
lines.21: 「Compromising here won't solve anything. We need to face them directly and keep talking.」
lines.22: 「But they aren't facing you directly in the first place.」
lines.26: 「But being right doesn't mean the world will let you win.」
lines.27: 「This class doesn't take anything seriously. Why get so worked up over it? You'll only make yourself look stupid.」
lines.29: 「Why are you saying that, Tsushima? You're the one who helped me!」
lines.31: 「I let you get hurt once already--so this time!」
lines.32: 「No. That's wrong. We're the ones making sense. If we keep talking, they'll understand. If you work hard, you can do anything. Dad always said so!」
lines.33: 「Your father's a police officer, right? Having a strong sense of justice is admirable, but...」
lines.34: 「Even Chinese heroes said there are times when retreat is sound strategy.」
lines.35: 「And they also said you must never bend your convictions!」
lines.36: 「There's no path to a solution here. We can't keep doing this.」
lines.37: 「I'm the one who's right! I won't back down!」
lines.38: 「That kind of rigid attitude won't work.」
lines.39: 「I'm not being rigid! I've offered a compromise too! Everyone should be able to accept that.」
lines.41: 「They already can't stand you taking charge.」
lines.42: 「Taking charge...? I'm only doing all this because no one else will step up!」
lines.45: 「I know it's unfair! But you have to put up with it!」
lines.46: 「You can't keep getting carried away like this!」
lines.47: 「No! I'm making sense. I refuse to back down when I'm right!!」
lines.48: 「W-why? I don't understand... What is with you?」
lines.49: I said it in utter exasperation.
lines.50: 「You work this hard... and this is the result... Why can't you see how stupid it is?」
lines.53: 「You brought up people talking behind your back... So basically, you're scared of people saying things about you.」
lines.55: 「Of course I hate it! But people will talk about you one way or another anyway!」
lines.56: 「If that's true, I'd rather act according to what I believe.」
lines.57: 「Even if you know the result will be meaningless!?」
lines.59: 「I'm absolutely right! I believe in myself!」
lines.60: 「If you keep charging ahead like that, you'll get torn to pieces.」
lines.61: 「...Learn to fit in with the people around you.」
lines.62: 「Fitting in with the people around you isn't the same as compromising and bending your convictions.」
lines.63: 「I-idiot!? You're far more stupid! You idiot!!」
lines.64: 「Hmph. Anyone who can't see what's around them is the real idiot.」
lines.65: 「I don't know why you're so twisted, but you're pathetic!」
lines.66: 「Looks like nothing gets through to Justice Konoe.」
lines.67: 「I don't even want to understand anything you're saying now.」
lines.68: 「Fine by me. I'm not helping anymore.」
lines.69: 「Ha! I wasn't counting on you anyway, idiot!」
lines.72: 「H-hmph. Go ahead and rot just as you are.」
lines.73: 「I'm just glad I found out what you're really like before you fooled me.」
lines.77: 「I don't even want to speak to you anymore!!!」
lines.78: 「Idiot idiot idiot idiot idiot idiot idiot idiot idiot idiot!」
lines.81: I left the classroom with Konoe shouting behind me.
lines.82: A lousy ending--we'd lost our tempers and wound up fighting.
lines.84: --Just as I thought, getting carried away never leads anywhere good.
lines.85: In the end, we settled nothing, and the day of the cultural festival arrived.
lines.86: When our class's turn for the play came, our homeroom teacher read an apology statement.
lines.87: That was where my relationship with Konoe ended.
lines.88: We've been fighting ever since, all the way to the present.
lines.90: And me, Leo Tsushima, never getting carried away.
